market_base_token_supply.meaning: baseToken supply of the small market before the mint

mint_amount.meaning: amount the attacker mints, equal to Q96

mint_rejected.meaning: the mint is rejected (reverts) because the mint amount exceeds the market baseToken supply or the Q96 cap

exploit_mint_multiplier.meaning: reported ratio of exploit mint amount to market size, 79 x 10^30

assumptions: The mint amount and market supply are both denominated in the same token unit as stated in the report.
The multiplier is a reported post-mint ratio of exploit mint amount to market size.

unresolved.description: The report states the exploit mint amount is 79 x 10^30 times the market size but does not give an exact arithmetic definition tying the multiplier to mint_amount and market_base_token_supply; the multiplier is bound as a reported observable only.

limitations: Only the multiplier_79e30 impact is formalized; other reported impacts are out of scope for this plan.

The relation requires both rejection of the over-supply mint and that the reported multiplier not reach 1; the exact reported magnitude 79 x 10^30 is carried on the multiplier symbol rather than as a derived formula.
